description.value:
Requirements You have a hand free.

You pull the Salbarium from your inlays into a chain fixed to your wrist. It lasts until Communion ends or you drop it as a free action. While it lasts:

  • You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} a creature up to 60 feet away, with the usual Athletics check. A successful Grapple drags the creature 10 feet toward you (20 feet on a critical success).
  • You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} at up to 60 feet: pull a lever, or snatch an unattended object of light Bulk.
  • Anchor 1 You hook a solid point within 60 feet and haul yourself there. This is a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Bcxarzksqt9ezrs6]{Stride} that ignores gaps and difficult terrain and can run up a wall.

The chain is an object (Hardness 15, 60 Hit Points) and needs a clear path.
